==Outpost facilities==
The Outpost contains various utilities, including:
*[[Bank]]
*[[General store]] - Sells unique items
*[[Anvil]] - Nearby is a smith who can repair [[Barrows]] armour
*[[Void Knight Archery Store]]
*[[Void Knight Magic Store]] - Stocks [[body rune|body]], [[air rune|air]], [[water rune|water]], [[earth rune|earth]], [[fire rune|fire]], [[mind rune|mind]], [[chaos rune|chaos]], and [[death rune|death]] [[runes]]
*Three {{wp|Landing Craft Vehicle Personnel|LCVP}}-style ships, called "landers" - Players board these to begin games of Pest Control
*[[Port]] (requires level 50 [[Sailing]] to dock your boat here)
